description: Searches the utility catalog (calculators, converters, checks) by free text in any supported language, optionally within one category, with one tag and/or for one country. Returns up to `limit` matches with slug, title, tagline, category, tag ids, country codes (empty = applies everywhere) and page URL. Ids for the filters come from catalog_list_facets; use catalog_get_utility for details.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive (e.g. "FI"): keeps utilities specific to that country plus those that apply everywhere.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "mortgage" or "miles to km". Empty lists everything.

name: catalog_search_utilities
title: Search utilities
